Line suggestion
Fixes several lines together (straight lines, circles, corners)
You drew %1$d lines! Shall I make them all nice and straight?
I can join the ends of your %1$d lines and tidy them up. Shall we?
Line suggestion: tap it and every line it considered is fixed at once (a single undo step).
Line fixing (2+ lines), template recognition (4+ elements close together) and AI settings.
Line fixing
Draw several lines and lift the pen: each line becomes clean and nearby ends join up. A single line gets no suggestion. We\'re drawing the moon with two arcs.
An object drawn with 4 or more lines close together is searched in the shape database and the mode\'s neural network: house, tree, face… We\'re drawing a house.
Fix lines
All the lines drawn together are fixed with one button. We\'re drawing pine trees.

In Select mode, select two or more lines and suggestions appear without pressing a button: text, shape and line suggestions in separate balloons. Suggest multi-fix on the selection bar opens the same suggestions.
From the ⋮ menu you turn AI on or off for this canvas; text, shape and line suggestions can be turned on separately. Suggestions run on your device and adapt to you as you accept them.
Turning handwriting into text (2+ elements) and fixing lines together.
Draw the four sides of a box as separate lines: the sides straighten and the corners join. We\'re drawing a box.
We\'re drawing three touching rings: one button turns all three into clean circles.
Comic-specific recognition (speech balloon, facial expressions) and fixing lines together.
We\'re drawing bubbles: one button turns them all into clean circles.
